in_hebrew.name: Fonseca
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Son of Sebastian
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fonseca הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Fonseca originated in Portugal. It is a derivative of the name Sebastian, meaning 'revered' or 'venerable'. The 'Fon' part of the name comes from 'filho', which means 'son' in Portuguese.

in_greek.name: Fonseca

It is a derivative of the name Sebastian, meaning 'revered' or 'venerable'. The 'Fon' part of the name comes from 'filho', which means 'son' in Portuguese.

in_latin.name: Fonseca
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Son of Sebastian
in_latin.long_meaning: Fonseca est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. The name Fonseca originated in Portugal.
